profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer | Architecting Intelligent, Real-Time Systems | Championing Self-Service Data at Scale
profile.summary: With over a decade of experience in software engineering, I focus on building scalable, self-service platforms that connect data products with data consumers. As a Principal Software Engineer at Zillow, my mission is to create modern, cloud-native systems that accelerate data adoption and foster decentralized ownership. Passionate about simplifying complex workflows, I aim to align technical solutions with Zillow's vision of transforming how people find and connect with homes.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
Technical leader for a company-wide strategy to unify streaming and event practices, enabling engineering teams to build intelligent, data driven systems that rapidly respond to user behavior across Zillow's integrated super-app.
- Wrote a highly influential strategy document (viewed by over 300 people, 30+ monthly viewers over 1.5 years) and secured engineering funding from senior leadership. Led the delivery of a self-service platform that has enabled over 15 engineering teams to deploy high quality, discoverable, and interoperable streaming datasets on top of a fully managed, self-service developer platform. Lead time to deliver new events dropped from days to minutes.
- Successfully scaled this initiative from 1 engineer (myself) to 13 including two managers and a product manager over the course of a year. Served as a technical architect, developed POCs across the entire stack, created strategic partnerships with leaders across the company, and mentored junior engineers.
- Pioneered the use of AI coding in my organization. Organized and led pair-programming workshops and gave presentations to accelerate adoption of agentic co-pilots (primarily Cursor) across our data organization. Developed and shipped an MCP server for our eventing platform that enables 100% agentic-based implementation of events by dynamically looking up event schemas and SDK documentation.

positions.title: Senior Engineering Manager, Data Platform
positions.description:
Led Zillow's transition from a data lake architecture to a modern data stack. Delivered a self-service data platform that has enabled over 140 teams across Zillow to successfully onboard new data workloads in minutes using a unified, cloud-native control plane developed in Kubernetes. Teams have successfully deployed over ten thousand resources including Kafka topics, Kafka Connect Jobs, Flink Applications, and event ingestion pipelines. Enabled decentralized ownership of data products through streamlined onboarding processes, high-quality documentation, automatic data observability, and federated data governance.

Led the successful adoption of dbt within Zillow’s data organization to dramatically streamline and simplify data pipeline development. 18 different teams at Zillow have adopted dbt and have used it to deliver 2000+ new models to production.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Designed and delivered a self-service, fully managed Flink platform enabling any engineer at Zillow to bootstrap and deploy production-ready Flink applications to Kubernetes with out-of-box monitoring, CI/CD, and diagnostics tools. This work enabled 24 different teams to rapidly adopt Flink for stateful stream processing with little or no prior knowledge. These Flink applications drive mission-critical product features across the company with 24/7 uptime, including home listings data and personalized experiences. 
- Designed and delivered a resource provisioning system backed by a custom Kubernetes operator enabling any engineer at Zillow to quickly configure and provision Kafka topics, ACLs, and many other resource types on a shared, fully-managed infrastructure.
- These two systems combine seamlessly to simplify all aspects of developing and running highly-available, event-driven services in production so Zillow engineers can focus on delighting their customers. As of May 2021, 60 different engineering teams at Zillow have provisioned over 1300 Kafka topics and 300 Flink clusters, all backed by a shared, fully-managed infrastructure running on thousands of nodes.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: Apache Flink · Apache Kafka

positions.title: Senior Software Engineering Lead
positions.description:
- Served as a technical project lead, designing and delivering a near-real-time distributed tracing platform for tracking and measuring the E2E performance of the Windows build, media creation, and test workflow. Took a lead role in designing a distributed microservice architecture for stitching together millions of telemetry events per day into a directed acyclic execution graph and using it to generate business intelligence in near-real-time. Promoted to Senior Software Engineer (Aug '18) based on my leadership contributions towards the successful delivery of this platform. A patent was internally filed for our graph generation approach.

- Delivered and maintained a 24/7 distributed cloud service. Individually implemented telemetry, distributed tracing, metrics collection, and live-site monitoring for three different microservices. Championed continuous integration and deployment practices within my team ensuring that all microservices and SDK packages could be automatically deployed, tested, and validated.
 Technologies used: C#, Azure CosmosDB, Redis Cache, Apache Spark, Azure Data Lake, Service Fabric, Azure Functions, Stream Analytics, Angular, SignalR

- Served as a platform evangelist within the organization. Drove platform adoption with 10 different partner teams by giving presentations to leadership, consulting with service owners, and delivering an SDK and accompanying documentation. Collected requirements from partner teams, designed features, and oversaw their execution and delivery by our engineering team.

positions.title: Program Manager 2
positions.description:
- Designed, secured funding for, and oversaw the construction of the Windows build system’s first comprehensive data model and pipeline to deliver key insights to engineering system stakeholders.

- Received a promotion (Mar ‘15) for delivering a distributed build technology and improving compile times by 60%.  Received a special performance award (Jan ’16) for leveraging data insights to improve distributed build throughput by 160% at no cost; the equivalent of $32 million cost savings.

- Established a long-term partnership with a data science team within Microsoft and acted as the primary point of contact, discovering insights and enabling tactical, sustainable improvements to decrease compile times by over 30%. Leveraged data science expertise to direct investigations of complex data sets including presentations to leadership.

positions.title: Student Researcher
positions.description: - Received first place at the ACM SIGCSE undergraduate student research competition in Raleigh, North Carolina, March 2012.

positions.title: Summer of Code Student
positions.description: - Worked closely with a JavaScript expert to research, define requirements, and build an open source API extension to Dojo Toolkit for accessing sensory data on mobile devices.

honors.title: Special Award for Performance
honors.description: Received a special performance award (Jan ’16) for leveraging data insights to improve distributed build throughput by 160% at no cost; the equivalent of $32 million cost savings.

honors.title: First Place - ACM SIGCSE Undergraduate Research Competition
honors.description: I received first place in this competition for my research into enabling parallel execution of JavaScript code on heterogeneous, distributed compute units in the cloud.
